description: APPLICATION-ARRAY-DATA-TYPE: application-level array data type with a defined element type and size.
name: app_array_data_type

description: Abstract base for application-level data types. Concrete subtypes are APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE, APPLICATION-RECORD-DATA-TYPE, and APPLICATION-ARRAY-DATA-TYPE.
name: app_data_type

description: APPLICATION-PRIMITIVE-DATA-TYPE: application-level scalar data type representing a single value with optional unit and computation method.
name: app_primitive_data_type

description: APPLICATION-RECORD-DATA-TYPE: application-level composite data type consisting of named record elements.
name: app_record_data_type

description: APPLICATION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: atomic application component that runs in an ECU partition. Owns ports and exactly one SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR.
name: application_swc

description: AR-PACKAGE: hierarchical namespace container identified by SHORT-NAME and optional UUID. Packages nest inside other packages and own model elements (component types, port interfaces, systems, …).
name: ar_package

description: ASSEMBLY-SW-CONNECTOR: wires a P-port on one prototype (provider) to an R-port on a sibling prototype (requester) within the same composition.
name: assembly_connector

description: BSW-SCHEDULABLE-ENTITY or BSW-CALLED-ENTITY: executable entity inside a BSW-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR that implements one or more BSW-MODULE-ENTRYs via IMPLEMENTED-ENTRY-REF.
name: bsw_entity

description: BSW-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR: executable semantics of a BSW module, containing schedulable entities, called entities, and event mappings.
name: bsw_internal_behavior

description: BSW-MODULE-DESCRIPTION: describes the internal structure and behavior of a Basic Software module, including its internal behavior and provided/required entries.
name: bsw_module_description

description: BSW-MODULE-ENTRY: entry point of a BSW module characterised by CALL-TYPE (REGULAR, SCHEDULED, INTERRUPT) and EXECUTION-CONTEXT (HOOK, TASK, INTERRUPT-CAT-1, INTERRUPT-CAT-2).
name: bsw_module_entry

description: CAN-CLUSTER: CAN communication cluster defining the physical and protocol parameters of a CAN network segment.
name: can_cluster

description: CAN-FRAME: frame definition for a CAN network, specifying frame length and signal-to-frame mappings.
name: can_frame

description: COMPLEX-DEVICE-DRIVER-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: atomic component that directly accesses hardware, bypassing the MCAL/ECU abstraction layers.
name: cdd_swc

description: Abstract base for communication clusters. Concrete subtypes are CAN-CLUSTER and LIN-CLUSTER.
name: comm_cluster

description: Abstract base for communication frames. Concrete subtypes are CAN-FRAME and LIN-FRAME.
name: comm_frame

description: COMPOSITION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: structural aggregation of SW-COMPONENT-PROTOTYPEs connected via ASSEMBLY-SW-CONNECTORs and DELEGATION-SW-CONNECTORs.
name: composition_swc

description: COMPU-METHOD: computation method that defines the conversion between internal values and physical values. Categorised as TEXTTABLE, LINEAR, SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE, IDENTICAL, etc.
name: compu_method

description: CONSTANT-SPECIFICATION: a named constant value with a typed VALUE-SPEC, used for calibration and initialization data.
name: constant_specification

description: CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE: remote-call port interface containing one or more CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATIONs.
name: cs_interface

description: CLIENT-SERVER-OPERATION: callable operation declared inside a ClientServerInterface. Has typed in/out/inout arguments.
name: cs_operation

description: DATA-CONSTR: data constraint that defines valid value ranges (physical and internal) for data types.
name: data_constr

description: DATA-RECEIVED-EVENT: event that triggers a runnable entity when new data arrives on a receiver port.
name: data_received_event

description: DATA-TYPE-MAPPING-SET: collection of mappings between application data types and implementation data types.
name: data_type_mapping_set

description: DELEGATION-SW-CONNECTOR: routes a port of a contained prototype through to an outer port of the enclosing composition boundary.
name: delegation_connector

description: ECU-ABSTRACTION-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: hardware abstraction layer component sitting between the BSW layer and application components.
name: ecu_abstraction_swc

description: ECU-INSTANCE: represents a single ECU node in the system topology, identified by SHORT-NAME within an AR-PACKAGE.
name: ecu_instance

description: ECUC-CONTAINER-VALUE: hierarchical configuration container inside a module configuration, identified by SHORT-NAME and a DEFINITION-REF. May nest sub-containers recursively.
name: ecuc_container_value

description: ECUC-MODULE-CONFIGURATION-VALUES: per-module BSW configuration container identified by SHORT-NAME and a DEFINITION-REF pointing to the module's parameter definition.
name: ecuc_module_config

description: ECUC-VALUE-COLLECTION: top-level container that aggregates all ECUC module configuration values for a given ECU extract.
name: ecuc_value_collection

description: EXCLUSIVE-AREA: concurrency protection region declared inside a SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR, used by runnables to guard shared data access.
name: exclusive_area

description: FLAT-INSTANCE-DESCRIPTOR: leaf entry inside a FLAT-MAP that identifies a single component or port instance in the flattened composition tree.
name: flat_instance_descriptor

description: FLAT-MAP: flattened view of the SW composition hierarchy, containing FLAT-INSTANCE-DESCRIPTOR children that represent leaf instances.
name: flat_map

description: I-SIGNAL-I-PDU-GROUP: logical grouping of I-SIGNAL-I-PDUs for Rx/Tx direction control per ECU and communication cluster.
name: i_pdu_group

description: I-SIGNAL: interaction-layer signal that represents a single data element transported over the communication network.
name: i_signal

description: I-SIGNAL-GROUP: a named group of I-SIGNALs that are transferred together as a composite signal unit.
name: i_signal_group

description: I-SIGNAL-I-PDU: interaction-layer Protocol Data Unit that groups one or more I-SIGNALs via I-SIGNAL-TO-PDU-MAPPING children.
name: i_signal_i_pdu

description: IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE: C-level data type with a CATEGORY attribute (VALUE, STRUCTURE, ARRAY, or TYPE_REFERENCE) that maps to a concrete implementation representation.
name: impl_data_type

description: IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE-ELEMENT: child element of a structured IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE, representing a single member of a STRUCTURE or ARRAY category type.
name: impl_data_type_element

description: INIT-EVENT: event that triggers a runnable entity once during component initialisation.
name: init_event

description: LIN-CLUSTER: LIN communication cluster defining the physical and protocol parameters of a LIN network segment.
name: lin_cluster

description: LIN-UNCONDITIONAL-FRAME: unconditional frame definition for a LIN network, specifying frame length and signal-to-frame mappings.
name: lin_frame

description: LIN-SPORADIC-FRAME: a LIN frame that is transmitted sporadically, containing a list of unconditional frames it may carry.
name: lin_sporadic_frame

description: MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP: named group of mode declarations used by MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACEs to define mode-based communication.
name: mode_declaration_group

description: MODE-SWITCH-EVENT: event that triggers a runnable entity when a mode transition occurs on a mode-switch port.
name: mode_switch_event

description: MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACE: port interface that carries mode switch notifications referencing a MODE-DECLARATION-GROUP.
name: ms_interface

description: Mixin that provides the stable_path identifier attribute, shared by all concrete AUTOSAR elements that are identified by their AUTOSAR path.
name: named_element

description: NV-BLOCK-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: atomic component that manages non-volatile data blocks through the NvM service interface.
name: nv_block_swc

description: NV-DATA-INTERFACE: port interface for non-volatile data communication between NV-block components and the NvM service.
name: nv_data_interface

description: P-PORT-PROTOTYPE: provided (sender/server) port on a SW-component. Carries PROVIDED-COM-SPECS and a PROVIDED-INTERFACE-TREF.
name: p_port

description: PARAMETER-INTERFACE: port interface for calibration parameter access between parameter components and consumers.
name: parameter_interface

description: PARAMETER-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: atomic component that provides calibration parameter values to other components.
name: parameter_swc

description: AR-TYPED-PER-INSTANCE-MEMORY: typed memory block allocated per component instance, declared inside a SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR.
name: per_instance_memory

description: Abstract base for Sender-Receiver and Client-Server port interfaces.
name: port_interface

description: Abstract base for P-port and R-port prototypes.
name: port_prototype

description: PR-PORT-PROTOTYPE: bidirectional provide-require port on a SW-component that both provides and requires the same interface.
name: pr_port

description: R-PORT-PROTOTYPE: required (receiver/client) port on a SW-component. Carries REQUIRED-COM-SPECS and a REQUIRED-INTERFACE-TREF.
name: r_port

description: ROOT-SW-COMPOSITION-PROTOTYPE: names the top-level composition instance within a System and points (via SOFTWARE-COMPOSITION-TREF) to the root composition type.
name: root_swc_prototype

description: RUNNABLE-ENTITY: smallest schedulable code unit inside a SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR, characterised by SYMBOL, CAN-BE-INVOKED-CONCURRENTLY, and MINIMUM-START-INTERVAL.
name: runnable_entity

description: SENSOR-ACTUATOR-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: atomic component that interfaces directly with sensors or actuators via ECU abstraction ports.
name: sensor_actuator_swc

description: SERVICE-PROXY-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: proxy component that represents a BSW service in the application layer for inter-ECU service communication.
name: service_proxy_swc

description: SERVICE-SW-COMPONENT-TYPE: BSW service component that provides AUTOSAR services (e.g. NvM, WdgM) to application components.
name: service_swc

description: SENDER-RECEIVER-INTERFACE: data-flow port interface containing one or more VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPEs (data elements).
name: sr_interface

description: SENDER-RECEIVER-TO-SIGNAL-MAPPING: mapping inside a SYSTEM-MAPPING that links a sender-receiver data element to a SYSTEM-SIGNAL.
name: sr_to_signal_mapping

description: SW-ADDR-METHOD: memory section addressing method that defines how data and code are mapped to memory sections (e.g. VAR, CONST, CODE). Used by the RTE and BSW for memory mapping via MemMap headers.
name: sw_addr_method

description: SW-BASE-TYPE: primitive machine-level type characterised by BASE-TYPE-SIZE (in bits) and BASE-TYPE-ENCODING (e.g. NONE, 2C, IEEE754).
name: sw_base_type

description: Abstract base for assembly and delegation connectors.
name: sw_connector

description: Abstract base for events that trigger runnable entities inside a SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR. Concrete subtypes are TIMING-EVENT, INIT-EVENT, DATA-RECEIVED-EVENT, and MODE-SWITCH-EVENT.
name: swc_event

description: SWC-IMPLEMENTATION: code artefact that realises a SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR. Links to the behavior via BEHAVIOR-REF.
name: swc_implementation

description: SWC-INTERNAL-BEHAVIOR: executable semantics of an ApplicationSwComponentType — runnable entities, port-access points, inter-runnable variables, and timing events.
name: swc_internal_behavior

description: SW-COMPONENT-PROTOTYPE: named instance of a SwcType inside a CompositionSwComponentType. Carries SHORT-NAME and a TYPE-TREF that points to the reused type.
name: swc_prototype

description: Abstract base for all AUTOSAR software component types. Concrete subtypes are Application, Composition, EcuAbstraction, and Service.
name: swc_type

description: SYSTEM: top-level ECU-integration descriptor that references the root CompositionSwComponentType via a ROOT-SW-COMPOSITION-PROTOTYPE.
name: system

description: SYSTEM-SIGNAL: system-level signal that bridges SW-level data elements and network-level I-SIGNALs.
name: system_signal

description: SYSTEM-SIGNAL-GROUP: a named group of SYSTEM-SIGNALs used to bundle related signals for composite data transfer.
name: system_signal_group

description: TIMING-EVENT: periodic event that triggers a runnable entity at a fixed PERIOD interval.
name: timing_event

description: TRIGGER-INTERFACE: port interface that carries trigger signals for event-driven activation of runnables.
name: trigger_interface

description: UNIT: physical unit (e.g. km/h, °C) with a DISPLAY-NAME, associated with data types and computation methods.
name: unit

description: VARIABLE-DATA-PROTOTYPE: typed data element declared inside a SenderReceiverInterface. Carries SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS.
name: variable_data_proto
